posts.name: armadagon
posts.cooked:
Nailed it first try thanks to Oxygen Leak w/12 cards in Wagner's discard.  Getting both Meteor Swarms out early made for some interesting plays.  Including having Legacy's Take Down last an extra turn.  Tempest used Into the Stratosphere to lock up Voss's draws, while Legs and Visionary cleaned up the riff raff.  Once Voss Flipped, I kept cleaing up his new minions so that he couldn't flip back.  On the final turn, Voss had just dropped Forced Deployment with 8 minions in his discard.  Tempest smacked Voss for 15 damage himself via Lightning Storm and Grevious Hail Storm thanks to his Gene-Bound Shackles, Legacy's Galvanize and Inspired Presence, and Visionary's Twist the Ether.  Legs then Thokked Voss, Galvanized, and Motivational Charged him.  Visionary then Demoralized him for another 3 damage, letting the Oxygen Leak finish him for 12 damage.  Amusingly enough, I finished with Tempest at 13, Legacy at 14, and Visionary at 15.

 

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=603921599

posts.cooked:
These are not getting any easier. I sat behind the meteor storms and built up an offense revolving around Legacy getting ready to intercept damage he was immune to, and when the time was right, I wiped the board with a Visionary + double Fire in the Biosphere combo. After that it was just a matter of paying attention, letting Tempest hit Voss every turn, and not letting Visionary do anything useful in the second half of the game so the base wouldn't blow up.

 

I drew almost all of Tempest's deck and never saw a flash flood. Pretty cruel, devs!

posts.cooked: Advanced - Mint. Crazy game. posts.name: stevelabny
posts.cooked:
i played regular and minted it.  I've been using the environment a lot in the earlier challenges but I didn't use it at all this time.

I sat under the safety of a Meteor Swarm for one round on turn 2or3  and then played Wrest the Mind on the ship to help me wipe the 6 minion build-up clean in 2 turns one of which I was protect by Heroic Interception. (Although I can swear that the first round it only let me redirect the damage 1 out of 3 times.)  After the board was clear, I sat Dark Visionary's base power on the environment deck while she played cards to keep cycling Voss' weakest minions on his deck,  while Legacy did his Galvanize + Motivational Charge every round, and Tempest did Vicious Cyclone for 1+2 from Legacy +2 from Shackles + 1 from Nemesis  = 6 plus Electrical Storm for 1 +2 + 2 + 1 = 6 plus Greivous Hail Storm for 2+2+2+1=7 plus the occasional one-shot for another 6-10.  Everyone was still in their teens when I finished.

Hadn't seen the advanced mode when I started it up. But I'm pretty sure with the way I was setup it wouldn't have mattered much.

Now I have a Good from week 1 (got my Ipad two days before) , a Near-Mint on the Miss Information because I stupidly didn't adjust to let the Krakens eat her, and mints on the rest .Not too shabby.

Near Mint on Advanced.  Forgot to Turmoil Voss and the Conqueror came out and did too much damage before I could kill it.  For the second game, made sure to Turmoil and put the ships/quark drive on the bottom.  Hid under Meteor storm until Tempest had Hailstorm and Genebound Shackles, Legacy with Fortitude, Danger Sense, Ring, Motivational Charge, Lead from the Front.  Did the Legacy skips for Countdown keeping Heroic Interception in play trick as well.  Suggestion kept Voss trash low so I could handle Forced Deployment. 

So afterwards I tried Regular, beat it first time and only got Near Mint.  I'm 90% sure I didn't rewind.  Although if no one else encounters this problem, maybe I did rewind and forgot about it.
